result:
PR #358 is out of draft and marked ready, and CI is green on its current head `7a85dc8c87`.

**Why the last attempt didn't finish:** it stopped "waiting on CI" and expected to be resumed when CI finished. Nothing resumes a lane when CI finishes (that's lane.toolsmith's defect 23, not built yet), so the lane sat idle. I wrote this down in `docs/lanes/boardprio/NOTES.md`.

**This session:**
- CI on the old head `0c53fffba2` had already passed: both builds, and the full jobs selftest at 1492 passed, 0 failed.
- I merged `origin/master` into the branch (a merge, not a rebase). It was 42 commits ahead. The only overlap under `jobs/` was two new selftest fragments (83 and 88) about the scoreboard, and neither touches a file this PR edits. The merged branch still changes the same 9 files, so the `Files:` line still matches `git diff --stat origin/master...HEAD`.
- `preflight.sh --allow-tracker` passed on the merged head.
- I watched CI on the new head in the foreground until it finished: both builds pass, and the selftest ran 1526 passed, 0 failed.
- I updated the PR body with both selftest totals and the merge sha, through the REST API (`gh pr edit` is broken here), and read it back to confirm.

**Still not done:** the brief's "one live board tick that dispatches onto a released file". That needs a territory row carrying `released`, which only the board can write once this folds; a lane may not edit `territory.toml`. The PR touches the board's dispatch path, so expect a `needs-audit-1` label before it folds.
